status: Local NEW proposed contract procedure; not jointly reviewed, adopted or playtested.
originalHook: OriginalCosmology paragraph322: Canian patent-heir knowledge and annual contradictions, refusal/Mephistopheles envoy. Detailed state/settlement/death/notice choices are NEW.

before: Issuer: Veyr of the Second Margin, Mephistopheles’ envoy for this Canian offer and licensed courier for the Canian engine patent office. This local license grants only the powers written here. It does not speak for every devil or mortal court and grants no authority beyond the owner-corrected Cania scope.

Offer and title: the named claimant is designated heir to the office’s three specified engine patents, CF-1 Isolation, CF-2 External Cooling Loop and CF-3 Pressure Seal. Acceptance registers this limited present title, gives one personal paper copy of all three plates, and permits their stated demonstration procedures. The title grants no past ancestry, other estate, soul claim, class proficiency, spell, feat or authority over other people. Its rights apply only to these named office records and the printed local bench arrangement.

Term and bond: informed signature or an understood witnessed mark on this exact document, together with deposit of50gp in actual coins, begins the term at timestampT0. Without the actual deposit no term begins. The first contradiction is due atT0+400elapsed24hour days, the next atT0+800days, and so on while the term continues. This contract chooses Aethel civil years. Descent openings, primordial Cycles, travel and session count do not change these deadlines. The50gp bond remains identifiable held property until a printed return or forfeiture.

Delivery: submit one fictional contradiction for each annual record by placing its written statement in the public quartz-panel slot or dictating it to Veyr at an actual public meeting. Identify two mutually incompatible claims, one actual observed record supporting each, and one concrete question that could reconcile them. Acknowledge known uncertainty honestly; fabricated evidence does not qualify. A previously accepted identical pair of claims and evidence cannot pay another year. Materially new conflicting evidence can support a new submission, with the changed record identified. No real-player secret or belief is required.

Review and grace: the slot retains the actual paper in a visible accessible drawer. Within24elapsed hours of an available issuer receiving it, Veyr gives a numbered written receipt identifying the annual record and the three required fields. A timely submission remains provisionally timely during review. Rejection must name the absent or nonconflicting field. The claimant has10days from actual notice to correct it; a valid correction completed exactly at that deadline resolves before termination. Accepted correction satisfies only its identified annual record. Delayed review or grace never rebases later annual due dates. If more than one annual record is outstanding, each needs its own qualifying submission; one physical delivery may contain several statements.

Examples: one actual record says a sealed chamber was empty atnoon; another shows a named witness inside atnoon; the question asks whether either clock was misread. Or one actual published proof says all accepted gate keys are iron and also records an accepted glass key; the question asks which premise fails. Rain on one day and sun on another do not conflict. The examples teach the form; they are not fabricated observed records the claimant can submit unchanged.

Departure: the claimant may end future participation by an understood declaration to Veyr or a signed statement in the panel. If the current annual record has already been accepted and no earlier record remains unsatisfied, return the actual50gp bond and end the term. Otherwise the claimant may first satisfy those records, or choose immediate exit by forfeiting that50gp bond. This is the entire exit cost. The finite patent title and demonstration permission end; the retained paper copy, learned information, soul, memories, hitpoints, class abilities and unrelated property are not erased or taken.

Default: an unsatisfied annual record after its printed due/grace interval ends the term, forfeits the actual50gp bond and ends the limited title and bench permission. This is the complete default consequence. No additional curse, compulsory mission, death, unbounded debt or automatic Paladin Oath breach is created. These consequences must be disclosed before signature.

Refusal: no term begins. Veyr may offer the separate free-will exercise, which may also be declined. Silence, coercion, incapacity, deception about these terms or another person’s signature cannot create informed acceptance. The claimant may negotiate a different complete written offer before signing; no change is assumed accepted.

Amendment: a new clause requires the claimant’s informed agreement to a complete visible revised document before it takes effect. Veyr cannot change a running deadline retrospectively. The old and new documents remain recorded.

Unavailable issuer: destruction of the panel does not destroy already written records or cancel an obligation; the claimant can arrange actual public delivery to Veyr. When the issuer is unavailable through a due date, a timely documented delivery attempt with the real statement retained gives10days after actual renewed availability to deliver that record. Each later annual record is tracked separately if the absence spans another due date. No extra cold cells, bench charges or duplicate patent copies appear during the absence.
after: Issuer: Veyr of the Second Margin, Mephistopheles’ envoy for this Canian offer and licensed courier for the Canian engine patent office. This grants only the printed local powers and no authority beyond the owner-corrected Cania scope.

Offer: the named claimant is designated heir to the three NEW Canian engine patents CF-1 Isolation, CF-2 External Cooling Loop and CF-3 Pressure Seal. Acceptance gives the actual three readable plates and the printed bench permission. No ancestry, soul ownership, class proficiency, spell, feat or unrelated estate follows. The substance and future use of these patent insights remain subject to the separate design review; the contract does not make a generic machine-repair power.

Starting the term: first explain all clauses in a form the claimant actually understands. A signature or understood witnessed mark, the actual50gp deposit, and actual access to the three readable plates must all be complete. Record T0 at that completion. No term begins while any is missing. The one finite paper copy set is physically supplied; already obtained readable copies can serve only if actually present and explicitly accepted by both sides. No stock respawns on a later offer.

Annual records: record1 opens atT0 and is due atT0+400elapsed24hour days. Recordn opens atT0+(n−1)×400days and is due atT0+n×400days while the term remains active. A statement can be submitted early after its record opens. Future unopened records cannot be prepaid. Each record is separate; accepting, reviewing, rejecting or delaying one never rebases another due date. These are Aethel civil years, not Descent rotations or primordial Cycles.

Statement: identify two mutually incompatible fictional claims, one actual observed record supporting each and one concrete question that could reconcile them. Honest uncertainty is allowed. No real-player secret or belief is required. Invented evidence and the same accepted claim/evidence pair reused for a later year do not qualify; materially new conflicting evidence can qualify if identified. The printed teaching examples show the form and are not free evidence that the claimant observed.

Delivery: complete a real deposit of the written statement in the functioning panel slot, or complete dictation to an actually available Veyr. Mark its annual number; if omitted, assign it to the earliest opened, unaccepted record. A physical delivery may contain several separately identified statements, each with its own real evidence. Record completion time, channel, contents and actual custody. A known completed filing is not erased by later paper theft or a damaged drawer; keep the session record and an actual copy or reconstruction for review. A blank promise to write something later is not a statement.

Review: an available Veyr reviews within24elapsed hours of actual receipt. If a functioning slot receives a timely filing while Veyr is absent, that filing is already timely; review begins on actual restored availability. A timely submitted statement or correction remains pending, rather than defaulted, while its legitimate review or required actual notice is outstanding. Rejection must identify all known missing, fabricated, duplicated or nonconflicting fields. Unknown truth or disagreement with a character’s belief is not itself a rejection ground. An objectively erroneous rejection has no operative penalty and must be corrected against these printed criteria.

Correction deadline: the first actual rejection notice for a record creates one10day correction interval. Its final delivery deadline is the latest of the original due date, that first-notice-plus10days, and any genuine availability extension. Later rejections do not restart the10days. Early rejection never makes the original annual deadline earlier. Complete correction exactly at the deadline counts. If it then awaits review, default waits for that review; if the correction is rejected after the fixed deadline, default occurs at the actual valid rejection notice, not retroactively. If no filing, correction or protected attempt is pending at a reached final deadline, that record defaults then.

Unavailable channels: if neither the panel nor Veyr can actually receive a statement at the relevant deadline, make a real timely documented delivery attempt and retain the actual statement. When a channel becomes usable again and the claimant actually receives notice of that availability, the held record has10days to complete delivery. This is a delivery extension for that record, not a new year. If several annual deadlines passed during genuine unavailability, each requires its own timely attempted statement. A paper already deposited in a functioning slot needs review, not a second delivery extension. A second actual outage can extend a record only with another real timely attempt against its then-current deadline.

Ending participation: before completing a voluntary termination, state whether its settlement is refund or forfeiture under the printed rule. A refund requires at least one accepted annual record and every record whose original due timestamp is at or before termination to be accepted. A newly opened but not-yet-due record is not demanded for exit. If the refund condition is not met, the claimant may remain active while completing the actual required work/review, or knowingly end immediately by forfeiting the original50gp bond. A mere request to learn the refund status is not itself consent to forfeiture. Actual termination ends future record openings, title and bench permission, but not retained knowledge, paper, soul, memory, HP or class abilities.

Termination notice: give an understood declaration directly to Veyr or complete deposit of a signed notice in the actual functioning panel. If both channels are genuinely unavailable, retain a dated signed notice and record a real delivery attempt with an actual witness or existing delivery record; that completed attempt can terminate the term under the same disclosed settlement rule. No fictional offscreen delivery is assumed. An invalid forged notice or another person’s unilateral signature cannot end the claimant’s term.

Default and death: one valid default ends the term and forfeits only the original50gp bond; no soul claim, curse, class change, automatic Paladin Oath breach or extra penalty is created. Actual true death also ends future annual obligations, applying the same refund-eligibility test at that timestamp to the original bond for the actual estate or designated recipient. Merely being Downed, unconscious or an active Undead-ancestry character is not true death. Later restoration does not restart the ended term. Record an unpaid legitimate refund until an actual authorized recipient can receive actual funds.

Settlement: return or forfeit only the original actual50gp once. If it was stolen or is otherwise unavailable, a refund can remain an unpaid ordinary claim; no coins appear and no annual obligation continues merely because the issuer has not paid. Amounts from that original deposit already returned to or physically recovered by the claimant are credited against its refund, not paid twice. If the claimant took the original bond before a later forfeiture, the issuer has at most the property claim to those same50gp, not another50gp penalty. All custody and ordinary consequences remain real.

Refusal and amendment: refusal creates no term and may lead to the separate free-will exercise, which can also be declined. Its ACCEPT slip is not a contract signature or deposit. Silence, coercion, incapacity or deception about the terms cannot create informed acceptance. An amendment needs a complete visible mutually understood document and actual agreement before effect; no silent retrospective deadline change or replenished stock. Preserve old and new records.

Neither path resolves higher cosmological identities.

after.timeFormula: For integer n>=1, openedAt=T0+(n−1)×34560000 and originalDueAt=T0+n×34560000. finalDeliveryDeadline begins as originalDueAt, becomes max(originalDueAt,firstActualRejectionNoticeAt+864000,all valid availability-delivery deadlines). No unavailability/review/grace event changes T0 or another originalDueAt.
after.reviewRules: Review begins when the actual statement and an available issuer coincide. Completion may be earlier than24hours; examples must state actual elapsed time. A filing completed by its then-valid deadline is protected during real pending review/notice. Invalid resubmissions do not manufacture repeated10day grace periods. A post-deadline rejected correction defaults on its actual valid notice; an accepted timely correction fulfills the record even after the deadline has passed. A rejection before the original annual date leaves that date available for correction.
after.notice: Actual rejection or restored-availability notice must be communicated to the claimant through a real understandable delivered message or encounter, with its time recorded. An unread paper merely left in the issuer drawer is not an actual notice. The issuer cannot impose a penalty by silently backdating notice. Genuine voluntary avoidance does not create an unavailable channel: ordinary filings can still be delivered at the known functioning panel.
after.receiptStock: Veyr has12actual blank receipt sheets. One receipt may record multiple numbered annual dispositions. Additional writing requires actual paper/ink supplied or acquired; a statement can carry its disposition on its own unused reverse when actually available. Missing issuer stationery does not invalidate an actual timely filing or create a claimant default. Dictation also requires an actual lasting record before it counts complete; use a supplied sheet or a genuinely available recording surface, not an imaginary infinite ledger.
simultaneousEvents: Apply actual prior effects/death and availability facts that already determine whether an actor or channel exists; no dead or absent actor performs a fictional Action.
Complete otherwise legal filings, corrections and communicated notices whose actual work finishes at this timestamp. Record physical custody and the existing record number.

Resolve any actually completed review now. A timely valid correction counts before its delivery deadline expires. A first actual rejection sets that record’s fixed first grace; a later rejection does not reset it.

Resolve an actually informed voluntary termination at this timestamp using all accepted records now known and every original due timestamp<=now. If settlement choice is not yet informed, no automatic forfeiture is inferred.

For any still-active term, open the next annual record at its fixed opening timestamp. Evaluate reached final delivery deadlines: accepted or genuinely pending-review/notice/held-for-availability records do not default; an unprotected unsatisfied record does. One actual default terminates the contract, with all other future records cancelled.
after.exitPredicate: refundEligible=(at least one record accepted) AND (every record with originalDueAt<=exitAt is accepted). If no refund eligibility, actual immediate exit is available only with understood forfeiture; otherwise remain active. Original due, not extended delivery deadline, defines which annual records must be accepted for a refund. A legitimately deferred but unaccepted due record therefore delays refund eligibility, not the freedom to forfeit and leave.
after.terminalStates: Any ended term creates no new annual records. Its unaccepted future records are cancelled; no late paper revives the term. Preserve all prior filed/defaulted/accepted facts. Title and future bench permission end, learned information and legitimately retained plates do not. New later terms require an actual new mutually understood offer and real prerequisites; no automatic replenishment or reset of this instance’s finite stock.

bondLedger.atActualStart: Transfer50actual gp from claimant to the real empty lockbox; record payer, custodian, held amount, prior returns/recoveries and destination.
bondLedger.refundAmount: max(0,50−amount of this deposit already actually returned/recovered by claimant or authorized recipient). Pay no more than actual available original-deposit funds; record any unpaid remainder.
bondLedger.forfeiture: Office acquires only the original-deposit claim; it does not generate coins or a second fee. If all50already lie in the office box, held coins simply change entitlement.
bondLedger.endWithoutPayment: Refund-owed is a terminal state with no future annual obligations. Payment later moves it to refunded once. A disputed or missing recipient leaves the actual money/claim in recorded custody, not a supernatural inheritance decision.
